parallelize_function_across_cores: parallelize a function across multiple CPU cores using multiprocessing on an iterable of inputs
separate_long_asts_with_sliding_window: separate long ASTs into smaller chunks using a sliding window for training and evaluation
get_ancestors_of_ast_nodes: get the ancestor chain for each node in a pre-order traversed AST represented as a list of dictionaries
extract_dfs_values_from_ast: extract depth-first search values from AST nodes returning node values or types
tokenize_camelcase_string: tokenize a camelCase string by splitting on uppercase boundaries and returning up to five lowercase tokens
